name: @local/lore
description: Lore memory plugin for OpenClaw with fixed boot baseline, recall hooks, and skill work copies

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --target=es2022 --external:openclaw/* && esbuild api.ts tools.ts hooks.ts uri.ts formatters.ts skills.ts --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --target=es2022 && node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs
